items.headline: Amazon announces multibillion-dollar agreement with Corning to supply optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions for its expanding U.S. data center infrastructure
Nvidia to invest up to $3.2 billion in Corning to expand U.S. optical manufacturing, including three new AI-focused facilities
Corning launches Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3, to debut on Motorola’s upcoming razr fold device
Corning Board of Directors declares quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share, payable September 29, 2026
